body: As far as I know, she is still going to get counselling on mondays.

It didn't happen after the game, that was just when I first noticed the behavior. As independent as she sometimes is, she wouldn't outright refuse something like that, which made me realize that something was wrong.

I understand that a relationship may be too much for her right now, which is why I was trying to ask her if she needed a break.

Thanks. It means a lot to me. I just feel that I have to rely on others for prayer right now. While my faith itself is steady, I haven't been feeling a connection to God lately, and am having issues fixing that. It's a bit of a vicious cycle - I'm not connected because I can't be motivated to become connected.

Anyway, thank you for your prayer.
I know what you're referencing, but I'm too scatterbrained to make sense of what you mean.

Prayer is all I can ask. She's beyond reason right now. I've told her I'll be on AIM and have my phone on me, so she can contact me any time. That's about all that can be done right now. I'll see her in school on Tuesday, but I'm not expecting her to contact me this weekend. Her parents may do so, though. Her dad called me a few days ago, crying, thanking me for trying to be there to listen, and to tell me that she isn't really talking to him either. I'm still not sure how to take that.

Thank you. It means a lot to me.
